text: Overall cognitive complexity of the counterarguments' own reasoning, as one integer 0-10 score: differentiation (multiple perspectives, distinctions, conditions, trade-offs) and integration (synthesis or qualified conclusion). Anchors: 0 no reasoning; 2 single simple one-sided assertion; 4 some reasons, little differentiation; 6 several distinct considerations or acknowledgment of alternative views/conditions; 8 clear differentiation plus integration with qualifications; 10 highly differentiated, integrated, nuanced multi-perspective reasoning. Reads only OC_comments (JSON list of comments by users other than the OP), judged jointly into one score, not a mean or max (operational assumption). Quoted text from others is not counted unless the commenter adopts it. Ignores OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules may count. Returns null if the column is missing/malformed or the valid list is empty.
